A1.justification: Both 27-page PDFs describe FlatQuant and contain matching main text, references and Appendices A–E. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish no material reading gaps.

before.justification: v3 reports original FlatQuant perplexity and QA results in Tables 1–2, latency measurements in Figure 4, and additional experiments and ablations in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains original FlatQuant benchmark results, latency measurements and ablations in the main text and appendices, including Tables 1–2 and Figure 4.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same affine transformations using Kronecker products, per-channel scaling, learnable clipping, blockwise calibration objective, Transformer integration and kernel fusion.

E1.justification: Coverage is unchanged: WikiText-2/C4 language modeling, six QA tasks, MT-Bench, C-Eval/MMLU/AIME2024 evaluations, and WikiText-2/C4/Pile calibration analyses appear in both versions.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains SmoothQuant, OmniQuant, AffineQuant, QUIK-4B, QuaRot and SpinQuant. Comparator membership also matches in Table 2 and all appendix comparisons, including the weight-only baselines in Table 11.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains 15 calibration epochs, 128 WikiText-2 sequences of 2048 tokens and batch size 4. Quantization settings, metrics and testing procedures throughout the main text and appendices are identical.

E4.justification: Component ablations in Tables 3 and 16, calibration/clipping/mixed-precision analyses in Tables 17–19, matrix-size sensitivity, and distribution/error visualizations are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical throughout. v4 adds or revises no run/seed information, uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, rankings, plotted results and qualitative findings match throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 2 reports 79.01% average QA accuracy for FlatQuant-RTN on LLaMA-3-70B in both versions.

T1.justification: Equations 1–7, the flatness definition in Section 4.4, and the computation and memory derivations in Appendix B are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical contributions and claims concerning flatness, quantization accuracy and inference speedup.

C2.justification: Interpretations of outlier suppression, flatness and efficiency are unchanged. Appendix E retains the same limitations concerning calibration-set selection and unexplored data types such as MXFP4.

D1.justification: Hyperparameters, SVD/AMP calibration recipes, hardware disclosures, training costs and kernel implementation details match. Code and implementation links are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The references, related-work discussion in Appendix A, and positioning against AffineQuant in Appendix C.9 are identical.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v3 dated 15 Jun 2025 to v4 dated 10 Aug 2025. Paper prose, headings, section ordering and appendix structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions and page layout are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–27 are pixel-identical; page 1 differs only in the version/date stamp text.

improvement.justification: v4 reproduces v3's methods, evidence, explanations and limitations, including the appendices. The version/date stamp update produces no meaningful change in rigor, clarity or reproducibility.
